component.name: OpenLingo
component.summary: Free and open-source language learning app

description.p: OpenLingo is a lightweight, offline-first, community-driven language learning application featuring 13 languages and 156 any-to-any courses from absolute beginner to super advanced mastery (English, Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese Mandarin, Korean, Arabic, Spanish, French, and Russian), interactive character charts and handwriting drawing boards, spaced-repetition flashcards, customizable language app icons, GitHub course catalog sync, and private zero-server Google Drive backup.

First public release across Web, Android, Windows (EXE setup, single-file Portable EXE, MSI, Portable ZIP), and Linux (AppImage, Flatpak, Deb, RPM, Arch, Tar, Zip) with native Android Google account picker, direct in-app updates on all platforms, updated Privacy Policy & Open Graph social cards, and refreshed README.

Native Android Google account picker popup with Google Play Services AuthorizationClient (no browser needed), direct in-app Android APK updates via PackageInstaller with live progress bar, and direct in-app Linux desktop self-updates across AppImage, Portable, Flatpak, Arch, Debian/Ubuntu, and Fedora/RHEL.

Immediate launch update checker with modal prompt, decluttered single-bar Characters view with All Characters selected first, full Tamil Uyirmei (216 + 48 Grantha) and complete Malayalam/Kannada/Telugu/Hindi consonant-vowel grids, global Add Course popup modal with source-language picker and search, and updated Support OpenLingo roadmap copy.

Full-bleed Android Adaptive Icons (zero white border) with non-crashing background launcher icon switching, custom Rich Purple themed option selector across all OSes, floating active lesson jump button, non-blocking top toasts, unclipped mobile exercises, true 3D animated flashcard flips, Course Studio moved inside Settings, legacy course cleanup, automated course & icon pipeline, and full CONTRIBUTING_COURSES.md documentation.

Flat Rich Purple 3D puzzle UI redesign with themed scrollbars and dropdowns, default-browser Google Sign-In on Linux desktop, full 13-language / 156-course beginner-to-mastery matrix with RTL Arabic support and handwriting boards for all scripts, circular 3D purple Malayalam (അ) default app icon, and customizable language app icons across web, desktop, and Android.
Zero-course new-user onboarding picker, active course management with + Add Course in Profile, and hardened Linux desktop port binding (SO_REUSEADDR + deterministic fallback ports).
Dedicated Profile and Settings pages with custom profile photo upload, Light/Dark/System theme selector, audio speed, transliteration and unlimited hearts toggles, and unified backup/logout controls.
Unified cross-platform icon and theme, last-synced indicator, GitHub Pages web app, and Linux desktop packages.
